title: Ventura County tornado motion and contacts
summary: Restore the recovered tornado material scrolling and decode the twister compound collision sections in the shared Rust engine.
details: The actor shader now applies the three distinct UV-scroll rates declared by the FREE06 twister materials.

A bounded decoder reads ten type-0 sections of each twister3 compound placement, creating thirty collision bodies across the three placements. Moving-body contacts follow current and prior MOT node transforms.
